What the workshop does

From the board above the workshop entrance and from what customers describe on Google.

Refill and recharge

Customers come to have their car’s A/C refilled. One called a day ahead for an appointment and was served right on arrival.

Leak detection and repair

The board lists leak detection dye. Customers report leaks found and the faulty part replaced within the same day.

Compressors, hoses, condensers

Repairs on all types of A/C compressors, making and repairing A/C hoses, and aluminium and condenser welding, as listed on the board.

Cabin filter and disinfection

Also on the board: checking and replacing the cabin filter, and antifungal disinfection of the system.

A specialist for car A/C

G.S Hadjisavvas Auto Air Conditioning Ltd works from a workshop with two roller doors at Galilaiou 29 in Limassol. On its Facebook page the company writes that it services and repairs air conditioning systems for all types of cars. The board above the workshop entrance lists compressor repairs, A/C hoses, aluminium and condenser welding, cabin filters, antifungal disinfection and leak detection dye. On Google, 81 of 85 reviews give five stars, and customers mention honest work, fair prices and problems that other garages could not diagnose.

What customers say

Three of 85 Google reviews, 4.9 stars on average.
